title.narrative: UNICEF Guatemala drove transformative climate resilience action by integrating child-sensitive approaches into national governance. Through ECO Agents, Resilient Municipalities, and strategic partnerships, over 3,000 youth contribute to shaping national climate agenda. Key achievements include pioneering intergenerational advocacy platforms, advancing inclusive budget tools, and embedding youth voices in national climate frameworks/dialogues.
